other_areas: diagnostic comparison only, not independent trades
window_definition: last three confirmed H1 closes, including current; maximum separation 2 hours
window_rationale: short bounded coincidence, admitting the one extra close needed to confirm two AO slopes; no profit/outcome search or alternative windows
confirmation_time: current close at which last required event becomes available; never earlier vertex
expiry: clear whole pending bundle when its oldest event age exceeds 2 closes
invalidations: opposite area cross or loss of alignment after cross
AO sign/recovery no longer valid after AO/area activation
ADX slope reverses its stored context
dedupe: event tokens consumed on confirmation/cancellation/expiry, no resurrection or persistent-state repeats
funding_and_execution: future strategy specification required; no fills or PnL in this diagnostic
